journeys.statement: From the public entry, sign up for the free trial, browse Drawing & Illustration classes, select a beginner course and begin the first lesson.

steps.statement: Open the public entry page.
Sign up for the free trial.
Browse Drawing & Illustration classes.
Select a beginner class.
Begin the first lesson and confirm the detail view matches every stated condition.

journeys.statement: Browse the catalog by subject and open a category and subcategory list page.

steps.statement: Use primary navigation from the public entry to reach the classes section.
Open a category hub page.
Open a subcategory list page and verify the destination heading and canonical path.

journeys.statement: Open a class page and inspect syllabus, instructor, materials, reviews and enrollment options.

steps.statement: Open a class page from a subcategory list.
Inspect syllabus, instructor, prerequisites, reviews, pricing and enrollment options.
Open a free preview or inspect class materials before enrolling.

journeys.statement: Inspect sign-in, registration and password-recovery entries without submitting.

steps.statement: Open the sign-in entry and verify the identifier field and identity-provider choices, then return without submitting.
Open the account-registration entry and verify identity fields, terms links and verification guidance without creating an account.
From sign-in, open password recovery and verify the reset-address field, validation guidance and return link without sending a reset.

journeys.statement: Create a learner account via emailed six-digit code and complete profile onboarding.

steps.statement: Submit the registration form with a new address.
Retrieve the six-digit code from the local mailbox and verify it.
Complete registration and basic profile onboarding.

journeys.statement: Sign in, open /myclasses, enroll in a class and see it in library, recent and watchlist.

steps.statement: Sign in and open the learning dashboard at /myclasses.
Enroll in a class, selecting a free or paid track where available.
Confirm the class appears under library, recent and watchlist.

journeys.statement: Choose a paid plan, enter sandbox payment details and reach order review and confirmation.

steps.statement: Choose a paid subscription option.
Enter sandbox payment details.
Reach order review and confirmation.

journeys.statement: Open an enrolled lesson, navigate units, record progress, resume from the dashboard and reach completion state.

steps.statement: Open an enrolled lesson and navigate between units.
Complete an exercise or assignment and review the result.
Resume from the dashboard, bookmark content and review progress and completion state.
Open certificate or completion options, leave a rating and manage learning preferences.

journeys.statement: Open account history; the newest item exposes status, detail, cancellation and a route back.

steps.statement: Open account history for class records and actions.
Verify the newest item exposes status, detail, edit or cancellation options and a route back to the collection.

journeys.statement: Empty required fields or signed-out actions surface inline validation or a permission prompt.

steps.statement: Open an action with required fields empty or while signed out.
Verify inline validation or a permission prompt identifies what must be corrected.
Open the public help, support or contact entry and verify guidance is reachable without exposing private account data.

journeys.statement: An impossible search and a non-existent deep link both return branded recovery views with primary navigation intact.

steps.statement: Search for zzzz-no-match-websitebench and verify a no-results message plus a route back to available records.
Open a non-existent deep link and verify a branded not-found view preserves primary navigation and offers a safe route back.
